detail: `{ format: "currency", currency: "EUR" }` renders an integer amount in the currency's minor unit (`4250` or `"4250"` for 42.50 EUR) through `Intl.NumberFormat` with the currency's decimals, grouping and symbol position of the UI locale, for example `1.234,50 €` in German and `€1,234.50` in English. An optional `locale` overrides the UI locale. The old `symbol` option is gone: it only appended the symbol to the raw value without grouping or decimals. A missing or malformed currency code or a non-numeric value renders the raw value.
migration: Replace `renderer: { format: "currency", symbol: "€" }` with `renderer: { format: "currency", currency: "EUR" }` (ISO 4217 code). The value is an integer in the currency's minor unit: multiply a major-unit amount by 10^decimals of its currency (×100 for EUR, ×1 for JPY, ×1000 for KWD).

detail: Lists get a new header, empty state, pager, toolbar, row actions and phone cards; the "…" menu only shows for overflow actions. New list options: `mutedRowField`, column `ellipsis` and `emphasis`, `dateOnlyAfterDays` on date columns, `toolbarSort`, `hideCountFooter`. `ListBadgeTone` is exported from `@cosmicdrift/kumiko-types` and badge tones also take the SelectOptionTone words. Record pages: `pageNavigation: false`, `mobileSummary`, `metricsPlacement.narrow: "before-steps"`, `MetricSpec.visibleWhen`, `photosBeside`, `recordSections.omitFirstTitle`, field option `concealed`, banner `iconless`; read-only groups with explicit `columns` render as a facts grid. Forms: banner variant `assist`, `FormProps.topBanner`, compact ConfigCascade, booleans as an off/on segment in settings, pinned footer actions with `hideIcon`, no cancel button in the drawer footer, drawers full screen on phones. Dashboards: progress-list `labelParams`, stat tiles as one text line on phones, the bell only renders with unread notices. The emptyState action no longer needs an icon. The i18n key `kumiko.pager.goToPage` is replaced by `kumiko.pager.pageOf`. Form fields: layout field options `badge` (`{ label, tone }` or `{ field, tone }`, type `FieldBadge`) and `hintField` (value field shown as a muted hint under the field); the badge sits next to the label. Number and money fields show a `suffix`/currency symbol right behind the number on a full-width field; textareas are four lines tall by default; choice chips are 26px pills (primary border and light fill when chosen); the hint of a field with `aiAssist` stays directly under the textarea, before the chips and the AI input. Record pages show the summary directly under the title, the status chip next to the H1 and the mobile summary left-aligned under it; destructive header actions move into the "…" menu; groups of a fields section render as labelled grids; a fields section description sits muted under the data (first sentence bold) on record pages; with `photosBeside` the data column is 380px wide. `photoGrid` gets `badgeField` (row text shown as a warn badge on the image) and tiles without `captionField` read "Photo n" (new key `kumiko.photo-grid.fallback-caption`); tiles are edge-to-edge images with the caption below, and the tile's per-photo actions stand in the caption row on the right (they wrap below it when a phone tile is too narrow). Next-step buttons are 36px high without icon and the "Vorher klären" chips wrap. Dashboards: stat strip tiles are separate cards on desktop, panel subtitles sit right in the head, the progress-list takes `subtitleField` (answer field shown muted at the head's right), the bar sits above the label row, a deadline cell uses the warn tone when the row has tone warn, `hideOnNarrow` columns stay out of phone cards, a text panel starting with a lead gets a primary accent bar and `**bold**` in paragraphs renders bold, the assist banner has a primary left bar. A list hint detail (`plainSentence`) is always muted text, never a tone badge. configEdit takes `compact: true` (no origin icon or reset link, no accent bar, uppercase group labels, form column max 940px). New list column options `multiline: true` (free text: wraps instead of ending in "…" and a line break in the value starts a new line, table and phone card; the helpdesk reply message uses it). A function-rendered column (reference columns) now shows its string `emptyPlaceholder` through the shared empty cell (translated, muted). A configEdit whose keys all carry `mask.section` keeps the feature description on its first section. The key-looking heuristic for `emptyPlaceholder` is gone: every string goes through translate and `cardAbove: true` (phone card: the column's line stands above the title, muted). A relatedList in tabs mode sits in a bordered card with a grey header row inside the page margin. Settings rows (`layout="row"`) put the control beside the label from a 384px container width (label and control share the row 1:1; the generated settings hub with `compact` is 940px wide, so it reads as rows), below that they stack. The photo grid sets its column templates as arbitrary properties (two columns on a phone, three from md) so a missing utility cannot collapse it to one column. Record pages, round 2: every projectionDetail section takes `tabLabel` (i18n key of the tab name; the `title` stays the card heading), `after` (a `{ react: { __component } }` slot drawn directly under the section card, also beside `photosBeside`) and the phone options `hideOnNarrow: true`, `showOnNarrowOnly: true` (exclusive), `titleOnNarrow: false` (no section title below `sm`); fields and writeForm sections take `descriptionNarrow` (short description on the phone), an edit field `{ field, hideOnNarrow: true }` leaves the grid below `sm`, `layout.narrowTabs: false` drops the tab strip on the phone so the visible sections stand one under the other, `header.narrowTitle` (i18n key) is the short title in the phone top bar, `photoGrid.badgeFirst: true` sorts tiles with a badge to the front. A writeForm section takes `submitWith`: the id of a writeHandler action in the screen's `actions`; the section then has no submit button, and that action sends its own payload plus the current form values in one write after the form validates (a form field named like a payload key, a `submitWith` that is no writeHandler action and two forms for one action fail at boot). The `after`, `tabLabel`, `descriptionNarrow` and `narrowTitle` texts are i18n keys. A navigate action takes `icon: false` (no icon, not even the id-derived default). A dashboard list `footerLink.label` is optional: without it only `moreText` shows, as muted text without a link. List columns get `hideWhenDocked: true` (leaves a table whose container is narrower than `md`, the docked assistant panel, while the phone card still shows it). Behaviour change on the phone: with `mobileSummary` set, the record header shows no status chip row and no subtitle under the H1, only the H1, the mobile summary and then the AI text.
migration: Lists that want the desktop sort dropdown set `toolbarSort: true`. Apps that override `kumiko.pager.goToPage` move the text to `kumiko.pager.pageOf`. Snapshot and DOM tests that assert old list, drawer or header classes need new expectations.

title: List cells stay blank when empty, truncate, and phone cards follow the board
detail: Empty cells render nothing by default (no more "—"); `emptyPlaceholder` is now `string | false` (an i18n key or literal shown muted in the empty cell; `false` keeps the cell blank). New column options `tone: "muted"` (whole column in the muted text colour) and `cardBadge: true` (the phone card shows the column right of the title as an outlined neutral pill; without one the first select column stays the badge). `RowActionDisplay` gains `"text"` (muted text without a button, e.g. a closed state). Table cells truncate with an ellipsis instead of wrapping (headers still wrap); a pill column shows its pill with a dot next to the cell text. Phone cards: a column with `emphasis` leads the card as a primary line with a sparkle icon and its pill on the right; `responsive` and `text` row actions sit in the card footer (the soft AI action on the left, links right); the card status pill sits right in the title row. A list facet bound to `namedFilters` is now appended after the other facets. A select facet reads only its label while unfiltered. The pager shows "0 of 0" (key `kumiko.pager.statusEmpty`) for an empty list, with an outlined page-size select and 32px outlined arrows. Stand-in screens (`visibleWhen` fallback) draw neither pager nor count footer. The phone sort line reads "Sorted by X ↓" without the count (key `kumiko.list.sort.summary` lost `{count}` and `{noun}`); the filter button shows a sliders icon. The new column option `hideWhenDocked: true` leaves a table whose container is narrower than `md` (docked assistant panel), measured with a ResizeObserver; `hideOnNarrow` only means the phone viewport. A list row (table and card) whose id equals the `ScreenFocus` record id is highlighted (light primary fill, 3px primary bar on the left). Relative times in lists (`relativeTime` format and the live formatter) read short and uniformly: "just now", "5 min. ago", "yesterday, 19:02", "2 days ago", an absolute date after 7 days, in all locales. A `hideOnNarrow` column is never the phone card title, the first visible column is; `cardAbove` columns do not count toward the three card meta lines; an `emphasis` column leads the card like a hint column, so a computed column with a renderer can be the "to do" line.
migration: Tests and apps that expect "—" in empty list cells set `emptyPlaceholder: "—"` or update the expectation. Apps that override `kumiko.list.sort.summary` drop `{count}` and `{noun}`. Tests that assert `whitespace-normal` list cells or long relative texts ("5 minutes ago") need new expectations.

title: Form writes carry a requestId and reuse it only for a safe retry
detail: The form controller passes { requestId } as third argument to dispatcher.write. After a transport failure without a server answer, a submit with the same values reuses the requestId, so the server idempotency guard does not run the write twice; any server answer or changed values get a new one. generateRequestId moved to the headless dispatcher module.
migration: Tests that assert a mocked dispatcher.write with toHaveBeenCalledWith(type, payload) must accept the third argument, e.g. toHaveBeenCalledWith(type, payload, expect.objectContaining({ requestId: expect.any(String) })). Custom Dispatcher implementations should forward options.requestId.

detail:
Final review batch F: renderer, renderer-web, types
The boot validator rejects a `listScreenId` that matches no mounted screen, a `sortable` column that the list cannot sort (entityList: any value; projectionList: `true`) and an authored `urlPrefillFields`. `TreeAction` is a union: exactly one of `screen` or `target`. `Button` without children needs `icon` and `ariaLabel`. `RenderEditControls` gains `next` and `back`, and `controls.submit()` saves on an intermediate wizard step. An actionForm money field with a tenant currency that cannot be loaded shows an error instead of submitting with a guessed EUR. The MFA setup and recovery-code buttons sit below the content. The boot context passes Redis to the delivery service, so `notify` with an `idempotencyKey` dedupes. `user:query:user:detail` skips the tenants label when the tenant feature is not mounted.
migration: Pass a number or "auto" to Grid columns; other values no longer type-check.

migration: Custom DataTable primitives that render `rowGrouping` handle `undefined` from `headerLabel` by rendering the group's rows without a header.

Wizard editing an existing record shows data-based done state and allows jumping to any step; delete record actions leave the screen
detail: Update-mode wizards compute done per step from the record (valid, non-empty fields, or passed via Next) and make every non-current step a jump target; forward jumps run the current step's validate gate. `ExtensionSectionProps.reportStepComplete` lets extension steps report completeness. `StepBar` gets `doneSteps` and `selectableSteps`. A writeHandler record action with `redirect`, or a delete of the shown record, navigates away (returnTo, redirect, listScreenId, entity list) instead of refetching.
migration: Extension wizard steps in an entityEdit that edits an existing record should call `reportStepComplete(true)` (usually from an effect) once they hold their data, otherwise the step bar shows them as not done until the user passes them with Next. This also applies to singleton wizards (e.g. a company-setup wizard), whose steps now show done by data and are all jump targets; tests that assumed back-only chips must be updated. A delete writeHandler action on a projectionDetail or entityEdit now navigates away after success (returnTo, else listScreenId or the entity's list) instead of refetching into "record not found"; set `redirect` to choose another target. List row actions are unchanged.

title: Screens fill the shell height by default
detail: entityList, projectionList, projectionDetail, entityEdit, actionForm and wizard screens now fill the height of the shell content. The table or the form body scrolls inside, the toolbar stays on top and the pager or action bar stays pinned at the bottom (`scrollBody`, `stickyActions`). The shell header is 56px. Custom screens and direct DataTable or Form usage are unchanged.
migration: Set `fillHeight: false` on a screen to restore the old page scrolling (table grows with its rows, pager below the last row, form footer in the flow). Apps with e2e or screenshot tests that scroll the page to reach the pager or the form footer need to adjust them or opt out per screen.

title: Pager shows a status line, page size select and Page X of Y instead of page numbers
detail: The numbered page list is gone. The list footer shows "1-19 of 19 <entities>" (with the entity plural label when known), "Page X of Y", previous and next buttons and a page size select (25, 50, 100). Lists without a pager show a plain entry count. The chosen size is kept in the URL under `<screen>.size`.
migration: Remove code and tests that click numbered page buttons (`-page-N` test ids); use the next and previous buttons. The screen's declared `pageSize` stays the default, `<screen>.size` in the URL overrides it. The new keys `kumiko.pager.pageOf`, `kumiko.pager.status.noun`, `kumiko.pager.pageSize`, `kumiko.pager.pageSizeLabel`, `kumiko.list.count.*` exist in en, de and es; apps with their own locale need them too.

title: rowActionMode adaptive has new semantics and mobile rows lose the kebab for plain navigation
detail: With `rowActionMode: "adaptive"` (the default), a table with `onRowClick` renders the first cell as a keyboard-operable link and puts all row actions into the kebab. Without `onRowClick` the primary row action is a link-button and the remaining actions go into the kebab (a single action gets no kebab). Below the md breakpoint a row that only navigates shows a chevron and no kebab.
migration: Code or tests that expect up to two inline row action buttons must open the kebab or use `rowActionMode: "inline"`, which is unchanged. To keep a visible action next to the row link, drop `onRowClick` and declare the action as the primary row action.

title: Form, wizard and detail screens use the board layout
detail: Screen forms have no card, sections are separated by lines, fields flow in rows with widths by type (text 240px, number 96px, money 160px, date and select 200px, textarea full row) and the page title lives in the shell header. Delete and Copy link move into the header kebab, the footer reads status, Cancel, Save, and the wizard footer has no Cancel. Wizard steps sit in a vertical rail from the lg breakpoint. The first detail header action is a button, further ones sit in the kebab. Detail screens have no header card and use the full width: metrics render as a dl band, tabs are underlined only when active, related lists are full-bleed with a count footer. Required-field asterisks are omitted when every field is required and "All fields are required." is shown instead.
migration: Adjust screenshots and DOM tests that pin the old card layout. `fillHeight: false` restores page scrolling only; the footer order, the moved actions and the new field layout apply in both modes. Empty list cells render a dash.
